judge.reason: The plan is appropriately lightweight: it runs inline with no subagents, creates no files, excludes policy and deployment work, and treats the absent history as a clean start rather than a blocker. However, it lacks an explicit acceptance check for each slice: milestones 1, 2 and 5 name a smoke test, unit tests or build+test, but milestones 3 (UI shell) and 4 (flows) have no stated pass criteria.
